I answered Pree in a thread reply to her message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

She posted this herself in #central-team on 9 June 2026. The morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift. Hollis said he would check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem using the store's login. I couldn't find any later update in that channel saying whether it was fixed, and I told her that.

I only used sources Pree can see herself: #central-team, #central-random and a public Central team file.
